name: lunar-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics and commands for Lunar components (.lunar) — the web framework in Lua.

commands.title: Lunar: Show the Lua this component compiles to
Lunar: Compile everything and report what failed

lunar.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `lunar` CLI. When empty, the extension looks for `bin/lunar` in the folder you have open and in each of its parents, then for `lunar` on your `PATH`. A relative path is resolved against those same folders, and `~` is your home directory. Run **Lunar: CLI status** to see what was found and where.

lunar.app.markdownDescription: The app directory `lunar dev` and `lunar map` are run against — a directory with an `orbit/` tree in it. When empty, the extension looks for one, preferring the nearest ancestor of the file you are editing.

enumDescriptions: Re-check the component as you type (debounced).
Re-check only when the file is saved.
lunar.diagnostics.run.description: When to run the compiler for diagnostics.

lunar.diagnostics.debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before re-checking (onType mode).

lunar.lua.markdownDescription: The Lua interpreter the CLI runs under, passed as `LUA`. When empty, `lua5.4` is used, which is what `bin/lunar` defaults to.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-grammar.mjs && node scripts/check-extension.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-cli.mjs
